## Research interests
I am interested in survival analysis and longitudinal data analysis, with applications in aging research and clinical trials. I look forward to deepening my expertise in biostatistics and building a meaningful career in the field.

## Research experience

**Biostatistics Research Assistant**, University of Georgia — Athens, GA | Oct 2024 – May 2025  
- Analyzed stroke patient data to identify key factors influencing severity and outcomes
- Ensured data quality, conducted statistical analyses, and generated visualizations using R.

**Biostatistics Research Assistant**, University of California, Irvine — Irvine, CA | Jun 2024 – Aug 2024  
- Analyzed neuropsychiatric symptoms in Down Syndrome and Alzheimer’s cohorts 
- Conducted data wrangling, visualization, and longitudinal modeling using R and Git/Github for version control.

**Biostatistics Research Assistant**, Columbia University — New York, NY | Jun 2023 – Jul 2023  
- Studied medical cost trajectories for lung cancer patients using R.  
- Conducted data cleaning, exploratory visualization, and applied survival and nonparametric analyses.
